chapter: Paul Barbarin and his own bands
title: The Lafitte Hotel trio and his Mardi Gras job
summary: Breaux recalls his trio with Noon and Sam at the Lafitte Hotel, and lists the players for his upcoming Mardi Gras job.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, Noon and Sam and I, we, we clowned around for quite a while in between band working. I mean, Noon and Sam and I played a trio worked out at the Lafitte Hotel for quite a while.
Told you you had some propit down there. You had some propit down there.
Well, no, we worked, just the three of us. we had to play and sing like that with Sam on the guitar and Noon with the bazooka and me with the bass ball.
Ever have Kid Clayton and Sam Lee outside?

Well, yeah, Clayton's worked with me too but not, not together with Noon and Sam. I mean, as a matter of fact, Clayton will be working with me Mardi Gras there. I have my own job Mardi Gras there right here on Royal Street at the American League in Coni and Ro. And I got Kid Clayton with me on that job. Kid Clayton, Harold De Jong, Sae, Eddie Summers on trombone, Smitty on piano.
Sounds familiar. I can't place it.
You know, Smitty, Smitty works, most of the time he works, he works with, with Harold De Jong.
You say Harold De Jong is now with Lawrence Marrero's band?

Well, no, he's, he's working Saturday on this job because Paul is out of town. but he's not an official member as yet. I expect Paul back soon. Well, Paul's supposed to be back for Christmas. I'm positive he'll be back for Carnival because he's, he's only, he's only, he's only supposed to be on a, on a business trip more or less.
